summary: The layers sound like DUMMIES: dry, physical and presentation-only, with the sim left untouched and hit-stop left on the registry. The remaining drift is in particle and streak roles. Sparks and the miss streaks are drawn in the reserved tier-1 and tier-2 cue colours, so they can pass for cues.

issues.rule: The cue.primary treatment is reserved for tier-1 cues, and decoration must not use it. The settled ring fix applied the same rule.
Write-off sparks are decoration and must not be drawn in the reserved tier-1 cue colour.
Straight speed lines in the cue.secondary colour behind the dummy imitate the lunge trace, an actual action in progress. After a miss the lunge has ended, so the lines suggest it is still running.
